title: How to check what version I am using?
body:
### How to check what version I am using?

Mon, 18 Oct, 2021

[Articles](https://smart-hospital.in/articles)[FAQ](https://smart-hospital.in/category/faq)

---

To check Smart Hospital Version, login from superadmin panel and then go to **Setup > Settings > System Update** link. Here you can see your current **Smart Hospital Version**.
